sd_definition: sample SD, divisor n-1, nonmissing values
missing_rule: pyreadstat user_missing=True; user-defined missing codes are counted as missing
n_distinct_rule: n_distinct is the full count of nonmissing values. n_distinct_capped_at_25 is min(n_distinct, 25). Distinct values are not listed. Day, weekday, week/phase, and design indicators add cell counts when n_distinct is at most 40. Labeled categoricals and other numeric variables with at most 10 distinct values do too, except age.
person_id_rule: person id entries contain n_distinct and the occasions-per-person histogram only
centering_rule: max_abs_person_mean is the largest absolute within-person mean of nonmissing values, computed only when at least one person has two or more rows. A value of 0 means the deposited rows are person-mean centered.

composites_equal_sums.parts: rSC where present, else SC, for items 1-26
